nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean energy|Energy management systems|Real-time energy analytics_qna_000
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: How was the performance of the energy-autonomous technology evaluated?
nodes.answer: The performance was evaluated through building energy consumption simulations conducted using DesignBuilder software and the EnergyPlus calculation engine.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean energy|Energy management systems|Real-time energy analytics_qna_001
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: Which software was used for simulating and analyzing energy consumption in the study?
nodes.answer: DesignBuilder software was used for simulating and analyzing energy consumption.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean energy|Energy management systems|Real-time energy analytics_qna_002
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What does the review by Padua in Energy Re's Soc SCI 2020 focus on?
nodes.answer: The review by Padua focuses on the complexity of energy behaviour, technologies, analytical traditions, and household energy consumption data in the United States.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean energy|Energy management systems|Real-time energy analytics_qna_003
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: Which specific energy app is being investigated in this study?
nodes.answer: The study investigates the Tibber energy app.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean energy|Energy management systems|Real-time energy analytics_qna_004
nodes.label: Strategy
nodes.question: What do the findings provide insights for?
nodes.answer: The findings provide actionable insights for improving app design, advancing smart energy solutions, and informing energy efficiency and conservation initiatives.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean energy|Energy management systems|Real-time energy analytics_qna_005
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What type of data do existing studies on energy apps predominantly rely on?
nodes.answer: Existing studies predominantly rely on theoretical frameworks or pilot-scale interventions rather than real-world data from active users.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean energy|Energy management systems|Real-time energy analytics_qna_006
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: How can analyzing user reviews of smart energy apps be beneficial according to the paragraph?
nodes.answer: Analyzing user reviews can provide valuable insights into users' perceptions and interactions with the apps, including their engagement with features, awareness of energy feedback, and perceptions of the app's utility for informed energy decisions.
